title: Detect Invalid Geometries
description:
A spatial database has been populated from multiple sources and some geometries are malformed — self-intersecting polygons, unclosed rings, and so on. Before running any analysis you need to flag the bad rows.

Goal

Return the feature_id and reason (from ST_IsValidReason) for every geometry that fails the validity check, ordered by feature_id.

Example Output

feature_id  reason
----------  ------------------------------------
2           Self-intersection[5 0]
4           Ring Self-intersection[2 2]
schema:
Table: features

ColumnTypeDescription
feature_idINTEGERPrimary key
geomGEOMETRYGeometry to validate

ST_IsValid(geom) returns TRUE/FALSE. ST_IsValidReason(geom) returns a human-readable string explaining the problem (or 'Valid Geometry' if it passes).
hints:
💡 Hint 1 Filter with WHERE NOT ST_IsValid(geom) to keep only the invalid rows.
💡 Hint 2 ST_IsValidReason(geom) gives you the exact failure message — useful for triaging which rows need manual repair.
starterCode:
LOAD spatial;

-- Return feature_id and reason for every invalid geometry.
-- Return: feature_id, reason ordered by feature_id
SELECT

FROM features
WHERE

ORDER BY feature_id;
